verdict.rationale: INPI publishes task-oriented guidance pages in its 'réaliser des démarches' section, covering trademark filing, choosing goods and services for a mark, online patent filing, software as a special case, provisional patent applications, design filing and e-Soleau. It also offers free expert support and Académie INPI training. The pack gives only page titles, though, so it shows that founder-facing explainers exist but not that they are plain-language or step-by-step. Missing for 10: evidence of the actual page content showing step-by-step, non-lawyer walkthroughs; independent or hands-on confirmation that founders can follow them without legal help.
